purpose: Prepare a receipt-bound five-arm A3 transfer, complementarity, and HarnessOpt execution bundle without starting measurement or provider work.

post_closeout_execution_boundary.transfer_matrix: each frozen winner may be compiled only against compatible target adapters; unsupported pairs are recorded and never substituted
post_closeout_execution_boundary.complementarity: equal-depth fixed-union controls precede any adaptive HarnessOpt batch
post_closeout_execution_boundary.harnessopt: at most three exact-four frozen batches; representations, model adapters, indexes, evaluator, data, and metric remain frozen
post_closeout_execution_boundary.hdev100: a non-adaptive diagnostic may report aggregate evidence but cannot tune transfer or HarnessOpt decisions
